notes: Gaps for the owner, not changed: (1) possible_own_account has no production caller yet; it is exercised only by tests, because pairing (R8/R9) is Tier 2 and cma run has one account. The design says 'when present', but the reviewer's gotcha on uncalled building blocks may flag it. (2) queue_candidates parses any rule_id containing ':conflict:'. Once overrides land (T16), an override whose free-text reference contains ':conflict:' on a line moved to OTHER would show phantom candidates. Overrides should be detected by line id, not by provenance text (the same lesson as verify-65). (3) Alerting, runbook and feature flag: not applicable. The tool has no remote alerting by design, and the queue is read-only output behind the existing CMA_RULESET path. (4) The 10,000-line timing came from a scratchpad probe the runner did not run: 6,314 entries in 0.075 s. It is not claimed above. T22's timed recompute (R52) should cover it. (5) Docs: README/design text for the queue belongs to T21/T22, which build the workspace view.
